description: This file defines an interface INativePeer with method signatures related to native operations involving tensor computations, such as resetting native state, forwarding input values, and running methods by name.

classes.name: INativePeer
classes.description: An interface that provides method signatures for interacting with native components, including resetting the native environment, performing forward passes, and executing methods by name.

methods.name: resetNative
methods.description: Resets or reinitializes the native environment or state.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs a forward operation with given input values and returns an output value.

methods.name: runMethod
methods.description: Executes a specified method with given input values in the native environment.
